title: A rectangle with methods
description:
Write a struct with methods that borrow, mutate and consume.

```
Rect 3x4: area 12, perimeter 14
can hold 2x2: true
after scale(2): 6x8
square 5: area 25
```
hints: `&self` borrows, `&mut self` can change the fields, and an associated function has no `self` and is called as `Rect::square(5)` (lesson 2.04).
`scale` needs `let mut r = ...` in `main` to be called.
requirements: `struct Rect { width: u32, height: u32 }` with `#[derive(Debug)]`.
`fn area(&self)`, `fn can_hold(&self, other: &Rect) -> bool`, `fn scale(&mut self, by: u32)`.
An associated function `fn square(size: u32) -> Rect`.
stretch: Add `fn into_square(self) -> Option<Rect>` that consumes the rectangle and gives a square only if both sides match.
